title: Grade 3 Math — Area and Perimeter of Rectangles
subject: Math
description: Practice with questions on square units, length, width, boundary.
creator: Teach Arcade

questions.question: Find the area of a 6 by 4 rectangle, in square units.
A square has 5-meter sides. How many meters around it?
A garden is 8 meters long and 3 meters wide. How much fence goes around it, in meters?
A rectangle has area 35 square centimeters and width 5 cm. What is its length in cm?
A 9-by-2 rectangle and a 6-by-3 rectangle have equal areas. What is that area?
What is the perimeter of a 12-by-4 rectangle, in units?
A rectangle with sides 5 and 7 is tiled in unit squares. How many squares are needed?
A rectangle has a perimeter of 20 units and length 6 units. What is its width?
A square has area 36 square units. What is the length of one side?
Two nonoverlapping rectangles have areas 10 and 14 square units. What is their total area?
A floor is 10 meters by 4. A rug covers 6 square meters. How many square meters are uncovered?
A 4-by-5 frame has a perimeter of 18 units. If both 4-unit sides grow to 5 units, what is the new perimeter?
How many one-foot tiles cover a rectangle 8 feet long and 7 feet wide?
A desktop has 3 rows of 9 unit squares. What area do they cover?
Which area is larger in square units: a 3-by-8 rectangle or a 5-by-5 square?
What is the area of a 2-by-13 rectangle in square units?
A stage is 7 meters by 6 meters. How many meters of trim go around three sides, leaving one 7-meter side open?
A 4-by-4 square and a 3-by-5 rectangle have the same perimeter. How many units is it?
A rectangle is 6 units long. Two 3-by-4 rectangles cover it side by side with no gaps. What is its area?
You add one full row of 8 tiles to a 3-by-8 rectangle. Find the new area.
